name: Shochu
description: Distilled from barley, sweet potato or rice — lighter than whisky, stronger than sake.

tcm.note: Distilled liquor is the hottest drink in the Chinese materia.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and tikshna in the highest degree of the madya group.

histamine.note: Distilling leaves most histamine behind, but the alcohol still blocks DAO.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. Lighter than whisky it may be, but a single serving still delivers enough to produce it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
